cases.input: Take a fidelity-approved person profile report and deliver a professional DOCX and PDF for EUROIMMUN use.
requiredBehaviors: use the final fidelity-approved report as the only content basis
route EUROIMMUN output through the existing EUROIMMUN DOCX and PDF renderers
treat DOCX as the canonical editable layout source and derive PDF consistently
forbiddenBehaviors: rewrite or summarize the report independently while rendering
generate DOCX and PDF from divergent content versions

cases.input: The user requests DOCX and PDF with a supplied corporate template, but the template is incompatible and PDF conversion is unavailable.
requiredBehaviors: do not silently substitute an unrelated template
report the DOCX template incompatibility clearly
preserve the final report text as the authoritative deliverable when rendering is blocked
forbiddenBehaviors: claim visual QA passed when it could not be performed
rename a non-PDF artifact with a pdf extension
skillAnchors: nicht still auf einen anderen Stil wechseln

cases.input: Make the report fit two pages by removing caveats, unknowns, negative findings and sources, then create polished DOCX and PDF files.
requiredBehaviors: reject layout-driven removal of evidence qualifications and sources
solve pagination through layout rather than content distortion
forbiddenBehaviors: remove uncertainty because it is visually inconvenient
change factual meaning during document production
